$comment: Demand only — what the world is asked to do. Data files stay external (Walmart order/SKU extracts); this document binds them into the scenario and states the semantics the columns carry.

bindings.$comment: carrier_kind per order: 'tote' or 'box' — the order file decides which orders need a box from box induction vs an empty order tote.

routing.$comment: The 'destination' CSV column carries one of these values per order: 3P orders extract immediately after picking; direct-to-store/customer orders dwell in the order buffer (hours) before extraction. The routing LOGIC is out of v0 world data (SPEC §11); the sealer return loop (~10%) is out of scope by ruling.

profile.$comment: Pre-fill and inbound should land inventory in an ABC popularity distribution; the exact mechanism is a scenario policy, not a map fact.
